methodologyNotes: ISBA advisory polls reflect participating attorneys, not ISBA or all attorneys. At least 60% agree on overall requirements is Recommended; no-opinion responses are excluded per question. Sample sizes are reported. An asterisk is insufficient responses, not a negative rating.
Committee evaluations are separate from polls. Nonparticipation can trigger a negative recommendation without a full qualifications finding.

Alliance organizations share an investigative process but issue independent ratings. Preserve each organization, blank cells, and no-fault footnotes; do not average or silently convert missing entries to Yes.
These ratings concern professional qualifications and conduct. They do not establish Republican/Democratic alignment or support for Trump.
Bar lists do not establish ballot status. Match against the official active electoral roster; this extraction excludes source-only Stephen A. Kouri.
The ISBA column in the Alliance table duplicates ISBA committee ratings; do not count it as an additional independent organization.

statusVerification.section: Judicial Vacancies for the 2028 Election / Downstate Vacancies
statusVerification.note: Official vacancy listing supplies the retirement date preceding the general election. This source-only bar poll is not an active retention candidacy.

verificationWarnings: Election listings use Marie Aileen Dempsey; the Cook court and bar evaluations use Maire Aileen Dempsey. Preserve the ballot spelling and candidate ID, with the court/bar spelling as an explicit matching alias. See audit/2026-11-01-gap-dempsey-name.md; no formal electoral correction is established.

ISBA Christ Stacey and ballot/CBA/Alliance Chris Stacey are explicit name variants for this judge. The official Cook court directory identifies Honorable Christ Stanley Stacey; do not describe Christ as a source typo.

Source-only Stephen A. Kouri is absent from the current active retention roster. Illinois Courts lists Stephen Kouri in the 10th Circuit Peoria vacancy table with status Retiring 07/31/26. Retain the bar poll as source-only; it does not establish current ballot status.
CBA spells Erin Haggerty Antoniett without the final i; the roster, ISBA and Alliance use Antonietti.
